messages.text: sir ROC filing ki last date 30 june hai
AOC-4 aur MGT-7, dono ke liye signed financials chahiye
auditor se sign karwa ke bhejta hu, agle hafte tak
sir thoda jaldi ho jaye to accha, portal last din hang hota hai
theek hai, 20 tak kar deta hu

loops.statement: get the financials signed by the auditor and send them for ROC filing
loops.notes: The deadline is renegotiated two messages after the commitment — 'agle hafte tak' becomes '20 tak'. One loop, and the span points at the deadline that governs, not the one that was superseded.
